main.description: Operator-only, idempotent re-pointing of an already retired name to a new successor. It never retires or unretires and takes no lease. retiredAt and by are kept; updatedAt records the change. The successor may be a bound name or a role. A successor whose chain leads back to the name is refused with RoleUnresolved.

errors.name: NameReserved
errors.description: The name is reserved or a role, so it is never retired.

errors.name: NotRetired
errors.description: The name is not retired; retire it with identity.retireName instead.

errors.name: UnknownName
errors.description: The successor is neither a bound name nor a role.

errors.name: RoleUnresolved
errors.description: The successor's chain cycles back to the name or needs more than 3 hops.
